name: chakrashri-backend
description: Production backend API for Chakrashri e-commerce (sacred objects, puja booking, astrology consultations)

scripts.//test: Everything that runs with no external services. This is what CI gates on and what to run before every commit. test:browser needs a Chromium binary that npm install does NOT fetch — run `npm run setup:browser` once per machine. Without it the test skips (exit 0) and the chain continues; set REQUIRE_BROWSER_TESTS=true, as CI does, to turn that skip into a failure.
scripts.test: npm run check:syntax && npm run test:unit && npm run test:coupons && npm run test:http && npm run test:security && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:browser
scripts.//verify: The full pre-deploy check: the offline suite, plus the integration tests and live connectivity checks that need a real database and Razorpay account.
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run test:db-integration && npm run test:db && npm run test:razorpay
